traits.name: Feign Death
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The opossum is reduced below 70 HP Effect The khravgodon collapses. It is flat-footed and can use actions that require only its mind, but any other action ends the ruse. A successful DC 18 Perception check to Seek or Medicine check to Recall Knowledge is required to determine that the animal is not, in fact, dead.

traits.name: Revived Retaliation
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The opossum is attacked or disturbed by a creature within reach while Feigning Death Effect The opossum Strikes the triggering creature.

traits.name: Crush Chitin
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The khravgodon has a creature grabbed or restrained Effect The khravgodon bites the creature, dealing 2d12+9 (2d12+9) piercing damage (DC 28 basic Fortitude save) that ignores the first 5 of the target's Hardness or resistance to physical damage. On a failed save, the target also takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC for 1 round.

traits.name: Grasping Tail
traits.text: A khravgodon can drag a Large or smaller creature it has grabbed with its tail along with it when it Strides.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +21 (reach 20 feet); Damage 2d6+9 (2d6+9) bludgeoning plus Grab
